title: John Rush's 78-tool stack: what he pays for to run 24 projects
summary: John Rush lists the 78 paid products he uses across hosting, dev, AI, testing, support, marketing, legal and more to run 24 projects, plus 4 of his own products. He picked each after trial and error on price, features and UX, and stays open to switching to better alternatives.

principles.text: Choose tools by trial and error on price, features and UX, and stay open to switching when a better alternative appears.
principles.quote: It took me many trials and errors to find best tools on price/features/UX.

principles.text: Stay open to switching tools: ask your audience for better alternatives and change if they beat what you use.
principles.quote: Do you know a better alternative? Let me know, and I may switch.

principles.text: Use a broad paid stack across hosting, DBs and clouds rather than locking into a single vendor.
principles.quote: Digital Ocean for hosting. AWS for hosting, storage, and CDN. Hetzner for bare metal.

principles.text: Use multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI) plus a vector DB for AI features.
principles.quote: Open AI for LLMs and image gen. Anthropic for claude LLM. Azure Open AI. Pinecone for vector db.

principles.text: Dogfood your own products to build sites, generate SEO content, build domain rating and speed up indexing.
principles.quote: SeoBOT to research & generate blog articles.
